title: Russia Continues Ground Pressure Near Pokrovsk and Myrnohrad
detail: Russian forces recorded advances near Pokrovsk and Myrnohrad in Donetsk Oblast on April 27–28, continuing weeks of grinding offensive pressure on the strategically important logistics hub of Pokrovsk. On April 28, 226 combat engagements were recorded over 24 hours, with Russia deploying 76 airstrikes, 247 guided aerial bombs, 6,251 kamikaze drones, and 2,283 shelling attacks against Ukrainian positions and populated areas. Ground advances during April 21–28 were recorded in or near 10 distinct Ukrainian settlements.

title: Putin Floats Victory Day Ceasefire to Trump in Phone Call
detail: Russian President Vladimir Putin proposed a temporary truce to US President Donald Trump, floating the idea of a ceasefire timed around Russia's May 9 Victory Day celebrations. Ukraine, learning of the proposal, countered by proposing a longer-term ceasefire rather than a symbolic pause. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov confirmed the broad outlines of the discussions, stating concrete details would follow. The proposal marked a new phase in Trump's mediation efforts between Moscow and Kyiv.

media.caption: Ukraine counters Putin's Victory Day truce proposal with long-term ceasefire bid
